title: n8n before 2.42.6, 2.43.x before 2.43.3, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability via…
description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in n8n versions before 2.42.6, 2.43.x before 2.43.3, and 3.x before 3.0.1. This flaw involves deprecated Function, Function Item, and LangChain Code nodes that run outside the task runner isolation, allowing authenticated users with workflow creation or modification privileges to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the main n8n process.
